name: Hardware-Splicer
pitch_50: Hardware-Splicer lets general-purpose AI agents perform bounded hardware-engineering work while deterministic constraints, provenance-bearing evidence, exact revision state, and scoped human authority prevent model confidence from silently becoming physical truth.
description: Hardware-Splicer is model-independent infrastructure for auditable agentic hardware engineering. A general-purpose agent can reason, inspect evidence, propose engineering changes, and operate the canonical engineering backend through MCP/API, while deterministic constraints, project/revision state, provenance-bearing evidence, physical-proof records, and scoped human authorization remain independently authoritative. The current external-proof checkpoint validates a frozen ten-case adversarial SPI-flash corpus, real MCP stdio and Streamable HTTP clients, stateful canonical project write/read/delete, 193 canonical backend operations, and an external-agent trace/replay harness that cannot independently grant physical authority. The primary bounded application is semiconductor test and validation support hardware such as adapter boards, carrier boards, fixtures, and lab/NPI support hardware.
limitations: Live external-model execution on the unchanged ten-case corpus, fresh revision-bound SPI physical correctness, independent human-operator completion, industrial economics, and production readiness are not currently claimed. Software/MCP verification is not physical proof. Hardware-Splicer does not claim universal hardware correctness, zero hallucination, autonomous certification, or replacement of a qualified hardware engineer.
